args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after the v2.3.1 deployment, with an error rate of ~18%. Action taken: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Note: the first rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east completed due to an orchestrator error); a retry completed the rollback successfully. Post-rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with an error rate of ~0.2%. Remaining follow-up: investigate the regression in v2.3.1 before any redeploy.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Rollback:**
- checkout-api's latest version v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- The first rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east completed, due to an orchestrator error), so I retried. The second attempt succeeded and **all regions are now on v2.3.0**.
- Verified post-rollback: the service is **healthy** in all regions with an error rate of ~0.2%.

**Incident:**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the health check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0 (including the partial-failure/retry), and the follow-up to investigate the v2.3.1 regression before any redeploy. (Note: the initial creation request reported a timeout, but I confirmed the incident was created and is open, so the on-call engineer has been paged.)
